metadata.question: Was water extent in the Sudd wetlands, South Sudan near Bor on December 4, 2021 higher than on December 6, 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location): - Collection: MODIS Daily Surface Reflectance (MOD09GA) for water detection (NDWI > 0.2) or the Global Surface Water product (JRC/GSW1_4/MonthlyHistory). - Date: December 4, 2021 and December 6, 2019. - Location: Sudd wetlands near Bor, South Sudan (approx. Point([31.58, 6.22])), a buffer (~30 km) to capture wetland extent. 2. Masking strategy: - For MOD09GA apply pixel_qa band mask to remove cloudy / shadow pixels. - Water mapping via NDWI (Green-NIR)/(Green+NIR) > 0.2 (>0.2 is dynamic surface water threshold), convert to binary. - Alternatively, get water occurrence >50% from JRC Monthly History band. 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Ensure at least 1 image per date (check .size()). - After masking area count total pixels (water + non-water) to verify any coverage. - Compute percent water by mean(binary_water). - If percentage on 2021-12-04 > 2019-12-06, answer A; else B. - Handle NaN/None from reducer as C3. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
pt = ee.Geometry.Point(31.58, 6.22)  # near Bor
roi = pt.buffer(30000)
d1 = ee.Date('2021-12-04')
d0 = ee.Date('2019-12-06')

# 2. Data Acquisition & Check
col1 = (
    ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD09GA')
    .filterBounds(roi)
    .filterDate(d1, d1.advance(1,'day'))
    .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 20))
)
col0 = (
    ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD09GA')
    .filterBounds(roi)
    .filterDate(d0, d0.advance(1,'day'))
    .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 20))
)
if col1.size().getInfo()==0 or col0.size().getInfo()==0:
    print("At least one date has 0 images.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")

# 3. Process: cloud-free water binary NDWI>0.2, scale=1000 to match MODIS
def water_mask(img):
    qa = img.select('state_1km')
    cloud_free = qa.bitwiseAnd(1<<10).Or(qa.bitwiseAnd(1<<12)).eq(0)
    ndwi = img.normalizedDifference(['sur_refl_b04','sur_refl_b02'])  # 500mB
    return ndwi.gt(0.2).updateMask(cloud_free)

# 4. Compute mean water binary per date
for tag, col in [('2021-12-04', col1), ('2019-12-06', col0)]:
    n_img = col.size().getInfo()
    print(f"{tag} Images: {n_img}")
    mosaic = col.map(water_mask).mean().clip(roi)
    tot = mosaic.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=roi, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('nd').getInfo() or 0
    water_sum = mosaic.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=roi, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('nd').getInfo()
    if tot==0:
        print("No valid pixels after masking.")
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    pct = (water_sum/tot)*100 if tot else None
    globals()[tag.replace('-','')] = pct
    print(f"{tag} Water {pct:.1f}%")

# 5. Final Decision
v21, v19 = globals().get('20211204'), globals().get('20191206')
if any(x is None or x>100 or x<0 for x in [v21, v19]):
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
elif v21 > v19:
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:
    print("<answer>B</answer>")
